intro: San Diego is a military town and it sounds like one. The 225–380 MHz military airband over Miramar, North Island and the offshore operating areas is the real attraction, and your VX-6 covers it in AM. Add a heavy Coast Guard presence and Mexican broadcast stations bleeding across the border and it is one of the more varied places to listen in the country.
introz: 圣地亚哥是个军事城市，听起来也确实如此。真正的看点是 Miramar、North Island 和近海演习区上方 225–380 MHz 的军航波段，VX-6 用 AM 模式正好能收。再加上活跃的海岸警卫队和越境而来的墨西哥广播，这里是全美收听内容最丰富的地方之一。

stations.d: Single runway with the famous steep approach over Balboa Park and the parking structure. Listening from Laurel Street is excellent.
stations.dz: 单跑道，著名的陡角进近要越过 Balboa 公园和停车楼。在 Laurel 街收听效果极佳。

stations.z: 南加进场管制（圣地亚哥扇区）
Borrego 与内陆无塔机场频率
stations.d: Glider operations at Warner Springs and desert strips out toward Borrego.
stations.dz: Warner Springs 的滑翔机作业以及通往 Borrego 的沙漠简易机场。

stations.z: Miramar 海军陆战队航空站（军航）
stations.d: Military aviation uses AM in 225–380 MHz, which the VX-6 tunes. Rather than trusting one number, scan the block in AM near Miramar or Coronado — the fast-jet and helicopter traffic is constant and unlike anything on the civil band.
stations.dz: 军航使用 225–380 MHz 的 AM，VX-6 可以覆盖。不必执着于某个具体频率，在 Miramar 或 Coronado 附近用 AM 扫这一整段——战斗机和直升机通话不断，和民航完全不同。

stations.d: Carrier and range operations offshore. Best from the coast at Point Loma, Sunset Cliffs or Torrey Pines.
stations.dz: 近海的航母与靶场作业。在 Point Loma、Sunset Cliffs 或 Torrey Pines 的海岸线上最佳。

stations.d: Navy small craft, sportfishing fleet, harbour police and Coast Guard all in one bay.
stations.dz: 海军小艇、海钓船队、港警和海警都在同一个湾里。

stations.d: From Mount Soledad or Cowles Mountain this covers the whole county and reaches into Baja.
stations.dz: 在 Soledad 山或 Cowles 山，可覆盖全县并延伸到下加州。

stations.d: Palomar Mountain and Mount Otay host wide-coverage machines. Confirm current PL tones on RepeaterBook.
stations.dz: Palomar 山和 Otay 山有大覆盖中继。请在 RepeaterBook 确认当前亚音频。

stations.z: 加州公路巡警边境分局（低波段）
美国边境巡逻队（联邦波段）
stations.d: CBP operates in the federal 162–174 MHz band. Much is now encrypted, but scanning the block near the border still turns up analog traffic.
stations.dz: 海关与边境保护局使用联邦 162–174 MHz。相当一部分已加密，但在边境附近扫这一段仍能听到模拟通话。

stations.z: 圣地亚哥警消 · P25 数字
stations.d: The San Diego Regional Communications System is digital P25. Not decodable on the VX-6.
stations.dz: 圣地亚哥区域通信系统为 P25 数字制式，VX-6 无法解码。

stations.z: CAL FIRE 圣地亚哥分区
stations.d: Santa Ana wind events make this one of the most consequential fire frequencies in the state.
stations.dz: 圣安娜风季使这成为全州最关键的消防频率之一。

stations.z: KPBS 圣地亚哥公共广播

stations.d: Licensed in Mexico, programmed for San Diego. A foundational alternative-rock station and a genuinely interesting artefact of border broadcasting.
stations.dz: 在墨西哥持照、面向圣地亚哥编排节目。另类摇滚的奠基电台之一，也是边境广播的有趣产物。

stations.n: KSDS — Jazz 88.3, San Diego City College

stations.d: Tune slowly across the FM band here — you will pick up Spanish-language stations from Tijuana and Rosarito that are far more powerful than their US counterparts.
stations.dz: 在这里慢慢扫 FM 波段——能收到来自蒂华纳和罗萨里托的西语电台，功率往往比美国台大得多。

stations.z: 墨西哥边境电台（整段搜索）
国际空间站 APRS 转发

stations.d: A Navy town is a good place to appreciate how much of the HF spectrum is still military.
stations.dz: 在一个海军城市，更能体会短波频谱里军方占了多大比重。
